title: Target Destroyed: MAG-12 and CVW-5 Execute Live Fire over the Pacific
description: U.S. Marines with Marine Fighter Attack Squadron (VMFA) 242 and VMFA-115, and Sailors with Carrier Air Wing 5 prepare to conduct a live-fire exercise at Marine Corps Air Station Iwakuni, Japan, April 12, 2023. Marines with MAG-12 and U.S. Navy Sailors with Carrier Air Wing 5 conducted a joint, live missile shoot over the Pacific to sustain their high-level of weapon proficiency, while serving as forward-postured aviation units in the Indo-Pacific region. (U.S. Marine Corps video by Lance Cpl. Chloe Johnson)
credit: U.S. Marine Corps video by Lance Cpl. Chloe Johnson
